steps.text: It was more than twenty years ago.
I remember that winter was so much colder than in previous years. The snow never stopped, and the wind was almost strong enough to blow you away.
The weather was so bad no one would willingly go outdoors.
Everyone stayed inside with their furnaces lit from day to night. There was always tea heating atop the stove for convenient pick-me-ups.
The burdenbeast sheds were specially reinforced before winter came, and the beasts huddled together, hibernating in groups.
Time seemed to slow down in Kjerag that year. Every passing day felt like a slog to go through, and yet the subsequent days would bring the same wind and snow.
I was still young then, and I just couldn't bear to live that way anymore. I snuck out with a few men in tow that day, with a plan to hunt in the mountains.

But the snow overwhelmed us, and there wasn't a single target to be found. I got separated from the others halfway, and could only continue ascending the mountain with all the effort I could barely muster.
And then, it was here...
I met Tatyana on this very spot.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Gah, what lousy weather today!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Don't even have a single strand of meatbeast hair on my hands, Dad's going to call me a...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What's that noise...?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Huh! Who's there?!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Enough with your tricks! Come out and face me if you have the guts to—

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Yowch!
As if responding to Arctosz's words, a snowball falls from a tree branch up high and hits his head.
A clear female voice rings from above.
Hahaha, right on target.
Hey, I'm over here.
Why didn't you hide, you big dummy?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Y-You..!
Me? What about me?
You're a funny guy. Did you think you'd be able to hunt in weather this bad?
Young man, I'll give you some advice on account of your handsome face.
You should hurry home.
Arctosz raises his head.
The snow and wind gradually subside, and bright rays pierce through the entwined branches of the trees before him, casting fragmented shadows on his face.
A vaguely female figure seems to pop up from a patch of soft snow.
Snowflakes scatter all around as she moves. The young Tatyana smiles as she looks down to meet the young man's gaze below.
Arctosz suddenly feels his eyes go dry.
The snowy white he is so used to is suddenly so dazzling.
The sunlight was so, so bright that day.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Saintess, please have a look!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: The main body of Kjeragandr's statue was built by us Browntails. It stands about thirty meters tall, and the adamant materials we used ensure no risk of damage for the next century at the very least.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hundreds of devotees volunteered to work together with professional craftsmen to carve out the statue's form you see today, so it's surely the most accurate reconstruction of Kjeragandr there is!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Although everyone was arguing about whether Kjeragandr should be humanoid or not... that boorish Arctosz even nearly got into a fight over it...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: But I guarantee you, from today onwards, this statue will be the most eye-catching attraction in Kjerag!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Mhm. Thank you for all the hard work.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: *cough* This statue... is the best symbol Kjerag can show to the outside world, and it couldn't have happened without everyone's efforts.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjeragandr will certainly be pleased as well.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Especially with you and your sister, Madam Sciurus.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I've heard the both of you spent a lot of effort on the construction, and practically stayed on-site until it was completed. It must have been difficult.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmm, hm-hmm...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: It wasn't much. Just doing our jobs.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Besides, it's much easier than being forced to study...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Study?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: No, no, nothing.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: *cough* Well then, Great Saintess. Allow me to give you a tour?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Please follow me!

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Saintess, preparations for tomorrow are complete. You should return to Mount Karlan.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You're nagging me again, Kjarr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It's rare I get to leave the mountain, so let me stay for a bit longer.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Or are you trying to advise the Saintess on how she should act, just as the Elders do, Kjarr?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I won't ramble away like they do.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Your gravitas only continues to increase, and there is no one to stop you from descending Karlan anymore.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Yesterday you came down to meet Enciodes personally. If this happened in the past, the Elders would have already raised a swift objection.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: They merely fear that I, the Saintess, will have my personal inclinations.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But it is precisely because there is no one controlling me that I cannot hold any bias... and I won't have any personal biases either.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Whether the people here or in the eyes of others, I must represent the whole of Kjerag as Saintess, and not any specific faction or clan.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Saintess...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Even though Enciodes and I don't actually have conflicting opinions on many matters and can agree on many issues regarding Kjerag...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It doesn't mean we can be as close as we were, let alone treat each other as siblings.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I can't do that, and neither can he.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It also... includes my own emotions, but it is not just about that.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: So I thank you for preparing our meal yesterday, Kjarr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But you need not do that again.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Enya...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Is it really alright to continue like this, Enya?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Even though you're representing Kjerag now, there are still many who only know of Karlan Trade. Clan Silverash has already started to dip their fingers in every facet of the country, and will only grow stronger in the future.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I have some thoughts on that.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: What's important right now is to develop Kjerag as fast as we can. Some matters are just unavoidable, or things I let slide.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: We still need entities like Karlan Trade after all.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Besides, I'm fine with Enciodes keeping himself there for the time being...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But won't it be dangerous to continue like that?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: That's why I have my own plans.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Oh, you mean the new school you've been in charge of the past few years? And the reforms over at the Vine-Bead Court?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It's fortunate I realized we have so many wise people here.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Compared to a Kjerag with the voice of a sole Saintess or a single Clan Silverash, wouldn't it be better to have a Kjerag with a myriad of voices of Kjeragandr's people?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It's the same as prayer. Didn't you say that making your wishes out loud instead of keeping them in your heart would let Kjeragandr hear them in earnest?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I hope more people will get the chance to voice their hopes for Kjerag.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: This is what I wish for, my prayer to Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Well... that's a good wish indeed.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: It will certainly reach Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: That's great to hear.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Will you help me, Kjarr?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Of course. Didn't we agree as much already?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I'm your maid after all.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Thank you, Kjarr.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: If you really want to thank me, why not...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Oh dear, they're headed this way.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjarr?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Is someone headed our way?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Yes, with an aggressive aura to boot.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: They're fast... they're heading straight here, hm... it feels like a fight is about to erupt.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Will there be any issues if that happens near the statue?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Who knows.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Anyway, you should return, Great Saintess. We also need to send someone to inform Madam Sciurus as well.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: It'll be bad if you or someone else gets hurt.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I will stay.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: If something happens... oh, it would be terrible if something happened to damage Kjeragandr's statue.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: So let me stay here to keep an eye on things, and I'll make sure 'nothing big' happens to the statue!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjarr...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...Hold on, you can't be...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Oh, they're here! I'll say no more, Saintess, I have to go watch them!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Hey, Kjarr!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: She's gone.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: She can't possibly be... looking for an opportunity to do a little something to the statue?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Is she that unsatisfied with the statue's face...?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: This part's easier to walk in, without as many trees around.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Careful, the snow ahead is pretty deep.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Uh, you... are you really my papa?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I-I mean, Mamochka said...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Tatyana mentioned me?!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Wh-What did she say?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Not much, I didn't even know I still had a papa until I was grown, I thought he might have died long ago.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I thought that was the reason she never mentioned a father, and she never really brought up Kjerag before either.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: We've been just the two of us for all these years, I never thought...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Really...?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Maybe, she... she still resented me.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: As she should have! After all, I was the one who let the both of you down back then. I deserve her resentment.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It seems Tatyana lived a good life, even without me...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Before I came here, she told me how the snow feels different in Kjerag. The snow you find on the mountain summits is different from the snow down here.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: She told me...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Kjerag is my home too, that even though I grew up in Ursus, I was born here.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Tatyana...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: That sure is something she would say. She liked the summit snows so much... and always told me how different it was.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It's a pity a thug like me didn't get it, back then.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hah, I don't get it either.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But I remember what she told me, I might have forgotten what happened when I was small, but those experiences don't just disappear.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: She always said, everything you've been through will always be shaping you as a person.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Even if you forget it, its influence remains.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: She said the Rosalind of today has every stage of her life to thank, and even the little insignificant things that happened in-between have also greatly contributed to who I am today.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And that's why even if she couldn't make it here, she hoped that I could at least know a part of me came from Kjerag.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: That's what she said, and that's why I'm here.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Tatyana...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: When your mother and I first met here, we... you could say it was a mutual attraction. It didn't take long for us to fall in love.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'd hoped to marry Tatyana and spend the rest of our lives together. I was really looking forward to it—I've never wanted anything as much as I did to be with her.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But that was no easy feat in Kjerag, back then.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But why?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: If you liked each other, then just stay together. It can't get any simpler than that, right?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Yes... it should have been the simplest thing to do.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But Rosalind, you don't understand Kjerag, or at least the way Kjerag was two decades ago.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: We were still secluding ourselves in our little corner of the land, and basically had no contact with outsiders.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You don't get Catastrophes in Kjerag, and everyone thought it was thanks to Kjeragandr protecting Her people. We believed the place was sacred, unlike the outside world, where Catastrophes are commonplace.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I've always believed Kjerag back then was quiet and peaceful.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But the way things are now, I have to admit, we were closed-off, and... blind.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Our lives were just farming, herding, and praying to Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Outsiders were rare to see, and we weren't exactly friendly to them either.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So Mamochka...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You know her best, I'm sure.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Tatyana was so passionate, frank, ostentatious, and didn't bother to fit in.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: She captivated me completely.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But at the same time, she was too strange and too different for Kjerag then...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So? Are you trying to tell me you held back because of that? You didn't dare to marry a foreigner?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wait, where'd I come into the picture then? You had me without marrying her?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm serious, beardy. You better not be joking.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Rosalind, wait! Don't be hasty... it's not what you think!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It didn't happen like that! Easy now!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Then what happened?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I *cough*, *cough* of course I married your mother!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Many objected to it, but it ultimately wasn't an impossible task. After all, the head of Clan Silverash married a foreigner too.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: My marriage would have been an embarrassment for the Paleroche clan, but I still managed to convince my father, our patriarch at the time, to go through with it.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You met him already, Rosalind. It was him who brought you back home yesterday, even though I was so drunk I didn't recognize you at all.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You mean... That old man...?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Is my grandfather?!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I appreciate that he ultimately let us marry, and kept it a secret from the others too.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: One of my biggest regrets is not inviting more guests to our wedding.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But Tatyana told me it was fine, that she didn't care about the formalities as long as we loved each other. Nothing else mattered, as long as we could be together for good.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: And then, we had you.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The days I spent together with you two were the best I could have ever imagined.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But our good times didn't last long. The Silverash couple got into an accident soon after you were born.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Kjerag was already in a state of turmoil due to the Silverash reforms, and there were many who regarded them as a thorn in their side.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Most didn't dare to challenge the Tri-Clan Leaders directly, but attacking a foreigner in private was much easier to do.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: They said it was an accident, but truth be told... it was far from that simple.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I don't know much about it, but I remember the Doctor telling me that the Paleroches are conservative.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So Clan Paleroche must have been against the reforms too.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'm not trying to lecture you now, Rosalind, but there are some things you have a right to know.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It was beneficial for the Paleroches to suppress the Silverashes then, and I alone could not have changed our decision to do so.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: So... we Paleroches are the most devout believers and guardians of Kjeragandr, while the Browntails are the astute followers who make sensible decisions.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: While the Silverashes had gone astray and tried to destroy our faith in vain, putting Kjerag in danger.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: This was how our three clans were seen back then, and also the way the situation really was in Kjerag.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: And I, as the next head of the Paleroche clan, could not harm the family's interests.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: There was not much I could do.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And so you abandoned me and Mamochka.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I did not!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I never abandoned you, and there's no way I would've abandoned Tatyana!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But those people, would they be satisfied with a mere 'accident'?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The Silverashes were dead, and I... married an Ursine woman.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: They didn't know how great Tatyana was, and didn't care for her affection towards Kjerag.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: She was just an Ursine woman in the eyes of many, an outsider representing Kjerag's doom.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Rosalind, I am a warrior. I've shed so much blood, and have never feared anything.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But back then, all I had were sleepless nights.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Because I finally came to know fear.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I was afraid...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The best choice I could make at the time was to have you leave, to go far away from Kjerag.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Even if we couldn't see each other again, even if I couldn't be by your side anymore.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: For I knew the two of you could live a normal and peaceful life somewhere at least...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Instead of running into any strange accidents somewhere I couldn't see—or even right under my nose.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: So I wouldn't be left with just an 'accident'...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: That's the story of me and Tatyana.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Rosalind, I owe you and your mother too much. I, Arctosz, will never deny this.
The warrior's weapon falls onto the snow with a muffled sound.
Arctosz takes out his poleaxe, and throws it at his daughter's feet.
Under the sun, it reflects both faces of father and daughter on its blade like a mirror.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Resent me, blame me, I deserve it all.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Berate me, or even strike me with this axe. I won't dodge.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But, then... can you give me another chance, Rosalind?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I... don't mean to make this difficult for you!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I just wanted you to know I still love you both. I did then and I always will.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: My feelings towards you and your mother have never changed.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: If you're willing, Rosalind—

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Could you... call me father, just once?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Call you... father?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Rosalind...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Go to hell! In your dreams!!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: R-Rosalind?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So you talked yourself in circles for a whole day, just for that?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: HUH?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Didn't want to make things difficult for me? You even threw down your rotten axe, because you're so sure I wouldn't use it to cut you open, huh?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: No, that's not what I...!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I don't care what you meant!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It sounds so neat, convincing your family to let you marry, being forced to make us leave.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hah. You think I'm dumb?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: All I can think of hearing your story is how Mamochka dealt with it all.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You left her all alone in a hostile environment for so many years, and she even raised a kid for you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: She willingly put herself in danger, even with her life on the line! But you're telling me in the end all she could do was leave??

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Have you ever considered why she, an Ursine, had to endure being treated like that in your Kjerag?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: My mamochka loved to go on adventures, she liked to try new things, she liked to explore anywhere she could. She could never stay in one place for too long.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: She loved making friends, loved shopping, loved to eat all sorts of food.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Could your Kjerag from twenty years ago even satisfy any of that?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Do you care about any of those things at all?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Why does it sound like you're the only character in your story, with nothing else?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You said she's passionate, that she's frank, but I couldn't tell you were talking about Tatyana Yevgenyevna Larina at all!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You're happy as long as you have your wife and daughter by your side?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hah...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm blown away that you actually had the guts to say that!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Tatyana...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It was me, it was my...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It's too late for tears.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Do you know what life in Ursus was like for us?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Living peaceful lives somewhere? That's enough for you?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Bullshit!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Do you know just how many people were talking behind our backs when Mamochka was raising me on her own?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You couldn't.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I grew up without a papa. Do you know how 'popular' fatherless kids are at school?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You were bullied?! They dared—?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Save it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: No one dared bully me.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But listen, it had nothing to do with you. It was thanks to my fists. Even General Zima helped me more than you ever did.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ever since I was small, I knew I had to rely on myself because I didn't have a papa. I knew I had to count on my fists to shut up those cowards who only knew how to use their mouths.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Do you know how many fights I got into growing up? Haha, how could you even?!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Rosalind...! I—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You don't have to speak. It's pointless anyway.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I just wanted to tell you, I don't care whether you were compelled by circumstance, or were trying to bear whatever burdens you had.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Since you were missing from our lives for over a decade, there's no need for you to step up now.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: My papa failed to show up back when I still wanted one.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And now, I don't need one anymore.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You're still hoping I'll forgive you?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Still hoping to use me as a bridge to reconnect with my mamochka, and have her forgive you too?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Dream on!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: No! I wouldn't dare make such an unreasonable demand!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But I, I just want to do something for you...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: ...No, hold on.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Rosalind, what did you just say? Have your mother forgive me?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But isn't she... isn't your mother dead?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You're cursing her too?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Who told you she was dead? HUH?!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But didn't you say, you brought her remains back here, and you've been using past tense...?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Right, 'remains'...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: ...'Remains'?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Uh, hold up, let me check.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: ...Uh, I mean, what was it, I brought back a token of hers.

spans.text: ...Uh, I mean, what was it, I brought back a

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Man, the Kjerag language is hard as hell. I know my pronunciation's a little off, and the tenses might be hard, but is it that bad...?

spans.text: Man, the Kjerag language is hard as hell. I know my pronunciation's a little off, and the tenses might be hard, but is it

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Tatyana is still alive? I-Is she doing well?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Super well. She just broke her leg in a fall right before our trip. That's why I'm here on my own.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But what happened in Chernobog a few years ago... Hmph, forget it. You wouldn't understand, even if I told you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll keep it short. I ran into some trouble a few years ago, and Mamochka ran straight into a Catastrophe to find me... I was pretty lucky to get rescued by Rhodes Island, but she contracted Oripathy.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: How could that...?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: So, where do you live now? Rhodes Island...? Right, they can treat Oripathy! So are you two staying with them now? Are they treating you well?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I know the Doctor there! Right, right, I'll get in contact right away!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Give me a break. You can't possibly know the Doctor better than I do.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Whatever, we'll pick this back up later. Another word and I'll lose my temper again.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What's important now is to find our way out of here, and it's no good to let that Victorian run around either, right?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Actually, I came up with an idea and was going to tell you about it, but you interrupted me.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What? How do we get out?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Over there.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You stand on that spot.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But Rosalind, that's just a cliff—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh? Of course I know that.
Leto stands behind the man claiming to be her father. She raises her leg again and kicks him in the back without a shred of hesitation.
Arctosz, completely unaware, only has a split second to look at her with a startled expression before his figure slips and falls down the cliff.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: AHHH—!!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Rosalind, careful—it's—oof!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Damn, you're pretty loud.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Stop yelling, you sound like I was going to end you...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I took a look earlier, and the short drop wouldn't do much with all that snow below.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What's wrong with you Kjerags? Do you guys not do any snowjumping here?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ah.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Right—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey, totally unhandsome beardy—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Don't forget to settle your child support for the past decade or so, I'll send the bill to your clan later—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hah... that felt great.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And now, hmm...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'd better tell the Doctor and the rest what happened here, just to be safe.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Sigh. I was supposed to be a tourist here, though, what the hell am I doing?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, I got through.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Doctor?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Are you here yet?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Yeah, I'm fine. But there's something I need to tell you...
